Fix a bug identified by Zou Nan hai <nanhai.zou@intel.com>:
If the system is in state SYSTEM_BOOTING
cond_resched() returns true even though it didn't reschedule.  Consequently
need_resched() remains true and JBD locks up.
Fix that by teaching cond_resched() to only return true if it really did call
schedule().
cond_resched_lock() and cond_resched_softirq() have a problem too.  If we're
in SYSTEM_BOOTING state and need_resched() is true
the lock and will then try to call schedule()
will prevent schedule() from being called.  So on return
still be true
column2: but cond_resched_lock() has to return 1 to tell the caller that

column1: the lock was dropped.  The caller will probably lock up.
Bottom line: if these functions dropped the lock
to clear need_resched().   Make it so.
